parsed.note_claim: Vaping does not cause popcorn lung, and diacetyl is present in cigarette smoke.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Does vaping cause "popcorn lung"? No, vaping does not cause "popcorn lung"... Diacetyl is contained in cigarette smoke, but it is banned as an ingredient in UK-regulated nicotine vapes and e-liquids.
parsed.reason: The NHS page directly states that vaping does not cause popcorn lung and that diacetyl is contained in cigarette smoke, substantiating key claims in the note.
